subject: Renewal proposal: priority SLA uplift + dedicated capacity
messages:
From: Lucas Bennett <lucas@hummingbird.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@hummingbird.ai
Date: 2027-06-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — priority SLA + capacity needs

Hi Priyom,

We're kicking off our renewal conversation for the 12/01 term and want to explore a tighter SLA package and a capacity uplift. Over the past 9 months we've hit several production spikes and the tail latency has started to impact feature launch timelines.

Specifically we'd like:
- A premium latency SLO (target p95 < 250ms, p99 < 800ms) or a consistent approach to guarantee tail performance.
- Reserved capacity for peak windows — planning for ~2x our current reserved GPU footprint during Q1.
- A clear procurement timeline (legal & PO) — target signature by end of July.

Can you share ballpark pricing for a premium SLA add-on + what a dedicated reserved pool would look like (throughput / cost)? Also curious if you can provide a short MA plan we can attach to our internal procurement packet.

Appreciate any templates or a one-pager you can send. Happy to set up a call next week.

Thanks,
Lucas
Head of Platform
Hummingbird Analytics

Attachment: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Bennett <lucas@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — priority SLA + capacity needs

Hi Lucas — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're excited to continue partnering with Hummingbird. I put together an initial package aligned to what you outlined and attached two artifacts: a short SLA uplift proposal and a high-level cost estimate.

Summary (high level):
- Premium SLA add-on: includes latency SLOs (we'll commit to p95/p99 bands by region), faster priority routing, and 24/7 priority incident response.
- Reserved capacity: proposal shows a 2x reserved pool with burstable standby; this reserves GPU capacity and includes a runbook for warm-up during traffic ramps.
- Migration/credits: we can offer a 12-week migration credit (applied as a usage credit) to offset initial uplift costs — details are in the estimate.

Requested next steps:
1) Review attached SLA-Uplift-Proposal.pdf and Estimate-Hummingbird-2028.xlsx.
2) Quick sync — propose 30 minutes on Tue 7/6 or Wed 7/7 to walk through numbers and procurement asks.
3) If procurement needs a concise MA plan, I can circulate a two-paragraph summary for their folder.

If it helps, I'm looping Marissa (Customer Success lead) and Aditya (Solutions Eng) to scope technical validation and on-call/runbook expectations.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA-Uplift-Proposal.pdf (3 pages), Estimate-Hummingbird-2028.xlsx
From: Lucas Bennett <lucas@hummingbird.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-02T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — priority SLA + capacity needs

Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the materials. A couple of questions from our side before the sync:

1) Credits & ramp: your note about a 12-week migration credit is promising — can you give the expected % of spend that credit represents? Our procurement team will want to see explicit crediting schedules.

2) Dedicated pool sizing: can Aditya outline the minimum vGPU / qps envelope required to ensure the p99 target is met during bursts? We're particularly sensitive to tail latency when we spin up new front-end models.

3) Cost guardrails: is there room to trade some per-token price for a longer term commitment (24 months) in exchange for lower unit rates?

4) SOC2 / compliance: procurement asked for the SOC2 report and the data retention policy for private deployments.

Procurement contact: procurement@hummingbird.ai (CC'd on my original). We'll aim to get you a calendar for the 7/6 or 7/7 slot by tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
Lucas

Attachment: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Hummingbird renewal — pricing and capacity ask (confidential)

CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL — quick plan for pricing response and ops scoping. Thread below for context.

Ask from customer: premium SLA (p95/p99 targets), 2x reserved pool, SOC2 evidence, and explicit procurement credit schedule. Procurement timeline: signature by end of July.

Recommendations (proposed):
- Offer a 12-week migration credit equal to ~15% of projected first-year consumption for the uplift period (applied as monthly credit). This helps offset initial uplift and speeds procurement approval.
- Dedicated reserved pool: propose 2x current footprint with auto-warm policy and standby burst capacity; include an Ops runbook and a 3-week performance validation window.
- Term trade: present a tiered discount if they commit to 24 months (additional 5% unit discount).

Pricing workup attached (internal numbers). If legal needs the MA plan, I'll draft a 2-paragraph statement.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm CS runbook and 24/7 on-call support obligations;
- Aditya: please provide required vGPU / qps envelope and a short note on KV cache pre-warming to hit p99 targets;
- Mina: confirm approval for the 15% credit and term discount authority or escalation path.

Timeline: want to lock language by 7/10 to meet procurement's July signature target.

Thanks — Priyom

Attachment: internal-pricing-workup.csv (internal)

Subject: Final renewal terms & SOW — priority SLA add-on (HB-2027-4321)

Hi Lucas — following our internal alignment, please find the final terms and next steps below. Appreciate the time and clarity from your procurement team.

Final commercial summary:
- Premium SLA add-on: p95 / p99 latency bands committed by region; priority routing + 24/7 priority response.
- Reserved capacity: 2x reserved GPU pool with 20% burst standby. Includes a 3-week performance validation window post-provisioning.
- Credits & term: 12-week migration credit equivalent to 15% of projected first-year uplift spend. Optional 24-month term yields an additional 5% unit discount.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II report and data retention summary attached for procurement review.

Attached: SOW-Hummingbird-Redlined.docx (redlines from legal), SLA-Uplift-Proposal.pdf, Estimate-Hummingbird-2028.xlsx.
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/1a2b3c4dSOW-Hummingbird (SOW for signature)
Drive (pricing workup): https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/hb-4321/pricing-workup

Requested next steps for Hummingbird:
1) Confirm acceptance of final summary above by reply (a single-line 'Agree' is sufficient).
2) Procurement to sign SOW via DocuSign link; target completed by 2027-07-25.
3) Once signed, Aditya will schedule the 3-week performance validation kickoff and Marissa will share the CS on-call rota.

If you want a brief handover call (15 minutes) when the SOW is sent to DocuSign we can arrange that same day.

Best regards,
